_: The bar's Lisää sheet, item by item. `sections` opens it and closes it again; this one goes through it. Vuosilakana and Asetukset are screens on both sides; Harjoituspaikat, Tietopankki, Jaetut kalenterit and Vie tietokanta close the sheet and land back where they started, which is this side's gap and what this records.

steps.name: Harjoituspaikat
steps.why: a screen the reference has and this side does not: the sheet closes and nothing opens
